citations.narrative:
The facility has not been maintaining all documentation of previous annual reviews of their contingency plan to include a
review that should have occurred in 2025. This site 006 became active on 21 August 2024, therefore a review of the
contingency plan should have been conducted and documented by at least 21 August 2025. The last review occurred on
05 June 2026 according to documentation produced during inspection. Reviewing the plan regularly ensures the facility
has made assessments for any needed changes to better prepare for emergencies. The facility shall develop and
document an appropriate contingency plan, as well as maintain annual review documentation and have it available for
APHIS inspections.
Correct from this date forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representatives.
